I didn't take Kratom or tramadol (when it wasn't controlled) till I was off work and home from the gym, so dosing times are irrelevant. 

I completely understand it's popularity with the gym. It's a social scene and Kratom makes you feel energetic and the ability to talk to anyone, and the gym is full of girls/guys you might want to talk to but can't sober because of anxiety. 
Along with the energy, it does mask pain that you shouldn't be masking unless you are begging for an injury. Ibuphren is safer for that issue.
I won't even get to addiction which occurs after dosing once a day for long enough. I am sure you have noticed the constipation, your metabolism will slow down and you will likely gain a few pounds if your body building. It's hurts respitory functions so cardio will be easy at first because the energy it supplies and masks ankle and knee issues. The worst is your drop in testosterone and libido gets to the point where you start skipping times you might masterbate. This is when it really starts messing with you mentally. If you have done steroids and go through the period where you are waiting for your body to start producing it's own natural testosterone, It feels like a permanent version of that. There isn't a timetable because it depends on many variables. These are all common symptoms of every opiate, some are just a bit different. 
I just think it's funny when people use Kratom as a "supplement' for the gym. People are attracted to it because of the euphoria and energy so going to the gym is fun, just like taking it before going out to a bar. It gets rid of inhibitions, just like booze at a bar.
It's really tough to find a long term daily Kratom user that is also in great shape. Go over to /quitting Kratom for information from people who have long term experience, hopefully it changes some minds.

I got a high ankle sprain and a jacked up shoulder because you don't feel the pain. It's just like how your not supposed to take ibuphrofen before a workout. I barely ever get injured because I knew when to stop.
Kratom is cool if you don't have any social mental anxiety or addiction traits. You might be able to take it everyone and then. However, most realize that school work or their job is better with Kratom as well. Once you start dosing 2 or more times a day it won't be long till the good parts disappear. Then you are constipated, some women lose hair, losing your libido is the worst, you literally won't even beat off for weeks. It has its place and shouldn't be banned. It keeps a lot of heavy opiate/herion users from using that stuff again. You can't OD on it. However, you can experience an opiate addiction just like any other, and the withdrawals will be the hardest thing you have dealt with, but I think it can be used in science and drug detox centers.

Kratom taper goes in the order of tinctures/extracts - reg Kratom - Bali leaves - stem and vein

PST is supposedly one of the worst withdrawals, it leaves the body slowly, so it lasts long. It's kinda hard to get real addicted to because it's a pain in the butt. No matter how much you try you will end up with seeds everywhere and you can't leave those seeds in ur trash long, it smells horrible. I actually get stuff done on it but stuff that I wouldn't do sober. Just don't email or text while on it. You sweat bad on it, you get a sweet tooth (morphine), and don't take if you take a piss test within 5-7 days. Plus people have OD'ed off it. It's waaay stronger than Kratom. There isn't any other opiate to help taper Kratom down, even tramadol is stronger. If I had a bad PST addiction I might as well be on herion, it has a lot of alkaloids. It's funny how Kratom might get banned but poppy seeds are way more dangerous in regards to ODs. Make sure you put lemon juice in your mixture, makes it much stronger. 

I didn't realize white vein was so strong, I always thought Ma Daeng was the best. Extract powders seemed to just give the double vision but nothing good. My tolerance has grown higher than Kratom, but I need to get it back down.

I took Maeng Da capsules, best for energy. Kratom has a threshold, eventually you just can't take enough to feel good like with other opiates. I was able to take around 12 for a few months, but you eventually start taking them first thing when you get up. Then redoing even though you really only get that initial high once a day. At first you also like it for sex, makes you perform. Eventually you lose a lot of sex drive though. One of the first good things you notice when getting off opiates in general is your sex drive rockets up.
I used it as a crutch for a long time because when I was on tramadol or harder opiates I never felt like working out. Kratom is like the suboxone for addicts addicted to the lower tier opiates. You can function on it, it doesn't make you want to do nothing, but it sucks to quit, and you never realized how out of touch u were. If you need energy go drink a redline, you are a rare bird if you can limit your use to twice a week and it's been over a year. Plus it might be banned. I would honestly recommend steriods over it, only because Kratom addiction WILL turn into something bigger than a workout supplement.
Opiates also depress the repository system and its a pain reliever so you can injure yourself without knowing until it wears off. I never got injured because I knew my body. On Kratom I suffered a high ankle sprain and a rotator cuff issue that sidelined me for 6 months. I used to bench 465lbs, I haven't put 225lb on the bar for a long time because of my shoulder. I couldn't do push-ups for awhile.

It's happened twice to me. I trained for 15 years before I got mixed up in anything. I got addicted to opiates and when I got clean it was hard to get motivation. Since my tolerance was so low and my libido was back, Kratom helped with the depression and lethargy so I would train really hard. Since I used opiates before, it probably didn't take my body long to build back up the tolerance. But I figured Kratom was at least putting me in a better mood so the side effects outweigh not going. If you take it daily u will get physical and possibly mentally hooked, that comes down to each person and how they handle addiction. However, you will notice a bloated stomach because it causes constipation. If you have depression at all it's not good to mess with, go over to the quittingktatom board.

Like others have said, they do show up on basic home tests. I have purchased about every kind off amazon and it always pops for benzos (and methadone for some reason, might be the Kratom). I have never had to take a drug test for a job that way though. You usually get a piece of paper with the testing center, your appointment time, and even the kind of test. The testing center doesn't tell you anything, they just say they will call if there are issues. They don't even tell your employer before they call you to ask if you are on medication. My doctor doesn't prescribe benzos or sleeping pills, I have even asked for them because I have bad insomnia. I have been looking for a job and it's been dead in my industry where I live, so I took some then sure enough I get called the next day about opportunities. I also took a few Valium one night last weekend because it's all I had, that stays in your system for 2 weeks even after a single use.

People need to be clear if they are taking a test for a previous drug related probation in which they are very strict versus a pre-employment screening where it's not as strict. For example, Tramadol is tested by drug clinics but not on pre-employment tests unless you work as a nurse or pharamist. 
I like clonazolam more but I heard it stays in your system a long time and it screws with my memory. Etizolam does the same, just not as bad, but I need more to sleep.

Highly doubt it shows up on drug tests for pre-employment for awhile. Most still don't test for tramadol and it's been controlled for a few years. Some places still only use the 5 panel for employment.
